initial_operating_mode.writer: Supabase remains the only production writer.
initial_operating_mode.self_hosted_role: private PostgreSQL restore and failover rehearsal target
initial_operating_mode.sync_mode: manual logical dump and restore for the first release
initial_operating_mode.split_brain_guard: production writers must be paused before any cutover; no bidirectional writes are configured

rpo_rto.target_rpo: 15 minutes after WAL/PITR or reviewed continuous replication is implemented and tested; manual dump/restore RPO is the age of the latest approved dump until then
rpo_rto.target_rto: 4 hours for controlled restore and app failover after restore drills pass
rpo_rto.current_state: staging Supabase public schema/data can be restored to the backend rehearsal database; production cutover remains disabled pending a separate approval

findings: Supabase supports CLI logical dumps for backup and restore workflows.
Supabase daily backups and PITR are provider-side recovery paths; Storage API objects are not included in database backups.
Supabase documents external logical replication to another PostgreSQL database, but it requires reviewed publication/slot setup and does not solve application failback conflicts by itself.
Supabase read replicas are managed read-only Supabase Postgres replicas, not this self-hosted backend target.

current_supabase_usage.postgrest_data_api: app uses @supabase/supabase-js with anon and service-role keys; self-hosted PostgreSQL alone is not API-compatible for production traffic
current_supabase_usage.rls_and_grants: public schema dumps include public RLS/grants; restore drills create Supabase API roles before replaying schema
current_supabase_usage.auth: admin authentication uses NextAuth Google with JWT sessions; Supabase Auth is present in local config but no production app dependency was identified
current_supabase_usage.storage: Supabase Storage metadata is excluded from the first restore drill because no app storage client usage was identified and Supabase database backups do not restore object bytes
current_supabase_usage.realtime: Supabase Realtime is not part of the first failover target because no app realtime client usage was identified
current_supabase_usage.edge_functions: no app dependency on Supabase Edge Functions was identified
current_supabase_usage.search: public search uses Postgres full-text search through public.search_articles
current_supabase_usage.backups: existing REST backup helper remains diagnostic only; the backend drill uses Supabase CLI logical dump/restore

target_topology.standby: private self-hosted PostgreSQL restore target; no multi-writer topology
target_topology.pooling: not enabled for the first release because the database port is private and app traffic is not cut over
target_topology.data_api: production app cutover requires a reviewed PostgREST-compatible layer or app-owned database API rewrite; do not point supabase-js at bare PostgreSQL
target_topology.network: database and Adminer management dashboard are loopback-only with SSH tunnel access; no public database port
target_topology.dashboard: Adminer is bound to 127.0.0.1:8082 through Caddy/PHP-FPM and requires an SSH tunnel plus database credentials

feature_mapping.Supabase Postgres tables/functions: public schema/data are restored to the backend rehearsal database and validated
feature_mapping.Supabase REST/PostgREST API: not cut over; requires later PostgREST-compatible layer or app rewrite
feature_mapping.anon and service_role keys: role names are recreated for schema replay only; production secret replacement is deferred until cutover design
feature_mapping.RLS/grants: public RLS policies and grants are replayed by logical schema restore
feature_mapping.Supabase Auth: not restored for the first release because the app uses NextAuth for admin sessions
feature_mapping.Supabase Storage: excluded from first release; object-byte recovery requires separate storage backup design if app usage appears
feature_mapping.Supabase Edge Functions: excluded because no app dependency was identified
feature_mapping.full-text search: pg_trgm is installed and public search objects are restored
feature_mapping.backups: service-aware restic covers host state; Supabase CLI dump/restore drill proves database restore mechanics

implementation_plan.required_evidence: protected Ansible check/apply installs PostgreSQL with localhost listen_addresses, no UFW 5432 rule, and generated local role passwords from GitHub Environment secrets
Adminer is installed behind Caddy/PHP-FPM on 127.0.0.1:8082 only and documented as SSH-tunnel-only

backend-postgres-failover-drill restore-staging dumps the staging Supabase public schema/data, restores to nutsnews_restore_rehearsal, validates required tables/views/counts, and writes /var/lib/nutsnews/postgres/status.json
ops dashboard, textfile metrics, and health report expose restore readiness, backup state, and replication lag status
separate explicit approval, paused writers, final production dump or reviewed replication catch-up, app compatibility layer, env switch, smoke tests, and rollback window

failover.trigger: manual incident decision after Supabase outage or data-access failure exceeds the incident threshold
failover.app_switch: not automatic; requires a later reviewed app/API compatibility change before production writes can move
failover.production_data_restore: manual protected workflow using production Supabase credentials is intentionally not enabled until staging restore evidence and cutover approval are reviewed
failover.rpo: manual dump age until PITR/WAL/replication is implemented

failback.reason: bidirectional sync is not proven safe for the current Supabase/PostgREST application model and could create write conflicts
failback.controlled_recovery_path: prefer forward recovery: pause writers, compare row counts and migration head, choose the authoritative database, then restore or migrate once through a reviewed production procedure

rollback.before_cutover: disable backend_postgres_enabled or discard the rehearsal database and keep Supabase as the production writer
rollback.during_cutover: switch app and worker environment variables back to Supabase, resume writers only after consistency is confirmed
rollback.after_cutover: rollback only inside the documented rollback window unless reverse replication is proven; otherwise run a forward recovery plan

manual_approvals_before_production_use: approval to enable a production Supabase dump/restore workflow
approval for app/API compatibility work such as PostgREST or an app-owned data API
approval of final production cutover timing and writer pause
approval of any reverse sync or failback procedure

validation.live_verification: protected apply plus read-only SSH listener checks and restore-drill status
